title: Second playtest (v0.9.1): first session, wars and diplomacy II–IV, platform and legal, monetisation integrity, late-game perf, store release
common:
Project: /home/user/Raivon — «Raivon: Territory Wars», portrait mobile hex-territory strategy in Godot 4.5.1 (Mobile renderer). HEAD is the v0.9.1 test build (ff2ee36, dev_log e914327) that the owner installs on a Samsung phone and an iPhone; the brief: make the game release-ready and perfect, never ask the owner. Since v0.9.0 the game got playtest fix batches B1–B4 (docs/dev/playtest_plan.json and its «dropped» list), commander portraits and chests v2, portrait tails T1/T2, art passes 5–6 (mountains, forests, quarry, camp, oil, capital DL1, aviation, destroyer), map performance R1 (buildings batched into map-wide MultiMeshes, deterministic chimney smoke, static banner cloth) and polish L1 (docs/dev/polish_plan.json). Three testers then played v0.9.1 with real touch input: A — the first session (fresh-install boot, FTUE steps 1–15, both tutorial wars, idle and slow players, ru/en at 941×1672 and 1080×2400), B — chapters II–IV and DL3–8 (wars, ultimatums, coalitions, diplomacy, late-game perf), C — meta, monetisation, returns after absence and a store-release audit. Their notes, logs, screenshots and driver scripts are under /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Raivon/6fa81df3-3b92-5348-855c-cb135734d3b5/scratchpad/playtest2/A, /B and /C; evidence paths in the instructions (A/…, B/…, C/…) are relative to /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Raivon/6fa81df3-3b92-5348-855c-cb135734d3b5/scratchpad/playtest2/. Drivers to reuse (copy into your scratch and update where the code changed): A/drv (play.gd + lib.gd + run.sh: real taps, a shot per step; idle, follow-then-wait and fresh-boot variants), B/drv (ph_ch2.gd, ph_ch2b.gd, ph_ch3.gd, ph_ch4.gd, facts.gd, ult_probe.gd, ult_probe2.gd, ready_probe.gd, verify2.gd, aiworld.gd) and B/probe_back.gd, C/drv (meta.gd phases shop/shop2/world/cmd/prof/ads/tall, away.gd + run_away.sh which back up and restore user://save.json inside the lock, lib.gd with a canvas→window tap transform for tall screens). game/tests/test_flow.gd shows how the FTUE is driven today. The triage that verified every high/medium in code and screenshots and grouped them into these steps: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Raivon/6fa81df3-3b92-5348-855c-cb135734d3b5/scratchpad/playtest2/triage.md. Know: docs/gdd (00_canon, 01_vision_core_loop, 03_war_combat, 06_diplomacy_peace, 07_progression_meta, 08_retention_liveops, 09_monetization, 10_ui_ux_art), docs/00_brief.md, docs/ui_style.md, docs/art_direction.md §6–7, docs/dev/how_to_run.md, docs/dev/backlog.md (known open items). Where a tester's suggested fix contradicts the canon, the canon wins — the instructions say so where the triage found such a case; say so in your report if you find another.
Rules: stay inside your step's owner_files. Three lanes run in parallel: the game-code lane (Q1 → Q2 → Q3 → Q4, one after another: game scripts, sim modules, data, strings, tests, project.godot, the privacy policy text), the map-performance lane (Q5: game/scripts/map_view.gd only) and the store/release lane (Q6: icon and key-art tools and files, the splash image, docs/store except privacy_policy.md, game/export_presets.cfg, the CI workflow). If a fix needs a file outside your owner_files, write the exact change as a patch file in your scratch dir and list it in your report. Godot: /opt/godot/Godot_v4.5.1-stable_linux.x86_64; every windowed run, import and test_flow runs under `flock -w 1800 /tmp/raivon_godot.lock` (check `pgrep -fa -- '--import'`). The machine has 4 cores shared with the other lanes' Godot/Blender runs: wrap long Godot runs in `timeout 900`, batch screenshots into one run, render Blender batches in the background. Screenshots: tools/godot_shot.sh OUT.png [--demo=...] [--tab=...] [--zoom=Z] [--dl=N] [--focus=q,r,z] [--res=WxH] [--select=q,r] --lang=ru --shot-delay=3 (read its header and main.gd _demo for every demo state); tall phone --res=1080x2400; standard look set tools/soft_shots.sh + tools/look_metrics.py (§6.12); read every PNG you make, crop and zoom (python PIL) to judge text and edges at real size. Budgets: godot_shot prints `perf draw_calls=… draws_canvas …` — UI screens stay at or below their current canvas count + 2 (ui_kit.gd KitBake rules); 3D views ≤ ~330 draws (3D + shadow) on strat/battle (Q5 brings the over-budget late-game views down; nobody may add draws there). Strings: game/locale/strings.csv (ru+en, both filled, «» guillemets in ru, “” in en per tools/check_strings.py). Saves: never leave the real user://save.json or user://settings.json changed — back them up and restore them inside the lock (C/drv/run_away.sh shows how); old saves must load (migrate new fields). steps.title: First session: a clean fresh-install start, a war 1 that cannot be lost, the Residence beat, tutorial rewards and timers
steps.instructions:
Fix every item below properly. Each was reproduced by tester A (twice or more, ru and en) and its cause checked in code by the triage — re-check the cause before you change anything, adapt where the suggestion is wrong and say so.
1. [high] Fresh install: the 28-day login calendar opens over FTUE step 1 and credits day 1. On a real first launch (empty user dir, no --fresh/--demo/--shot args) «Календарь «Новобранец» День 1/28» opens ~2 s after the splash over Bram's step-1 line and the ringed «Война!»; day 1 is credited at once (gold 1000→1340), the window stays after «Забрать», and holding «Война!» does nothing while it is open. Cause (verified): main.gd _ready calls _econ_tick() at line 278 before `elif save_enabled: ftue = 1` at 286; _econ_tick → _calendar_tick (4678, 5753) → _orders_open() is just `ftue == 0` (5612), so calendar.visit credits day 1 and _open_calendar runs. The same gate lets the «Приказы дня» chip (_orders_chip 5728) and the orders/weekly ticks (5401, 5636, 5675, 5729) run in the tutorial's ftue==0 gaps (ceremony 1 with _ftue_next=7, the raid lesson with _ftue_next=10 / _raid_hold). Also _grant_bram() (280) runs on a fresh save because ftue is still 0 there. Evidence: A/boot/std_en/boot_t*.png, A/boot/tall_ru/boot_t*.png, A/r_ru/01_r_first_second.jpg, 03_r_after_first_window.jpg, 05_r_declared.jpg and log.txt («modal=true calendar pending=true credited=1», «held 8.2s real, fired=false»), A/r_en/03; orders chip during the tutorial A/x_lcol.jpg, A/b_ru2/09_ftue9_fort_started.jpg, A/b_ru2/25_tutorial_card.jpg («0/3» chip). Fix: decide the fresh save's ftue before the first _econ_tick; add a persisted `stats.ftue_done` set when the tutorial really ends (the tutorial card's «Вперёд», and the early exits that set ftue = 0 for good: 4593, 8094 and _raid_hold's no-Hamlets branch) and make _orders_open() read it (migrate: an old save with ftue == 0 and _ftue_next == 0 gets the flag on load); grant Bram only where the story gives him (4110). Canon 08 §8.8.1 (line 382, 391): calendar day 1 comes on the install day after the FTUE, opened outside protected states — open it after «Вперёд» and the colonize hint, never over the tutorial card. Acceptance: a real fresh boot (no args, empty user dir; back up the real user:// files) at 941×1672 and 1080×2400 in ru and en shows no modal, the step-1 coach from the first frame after the splash, and a hold on «Война!» declares; no orders chip and no calendar until the tutorial card closes; then the calendar opens once with day 1. test_flow case: a fresh save with save_enabled (temp save path or a Save path override for tests) → no modal, ftue == 1, calendar day not credited.
2. [high] An idle or late player loses war 1 and the coached retry cannot win. If the player does not drag in the first 60 s, war 1 ends «Ничья · Время вышло · 0 захвачено · −1,0»; on «Ещё бой» the step-3 ghost goes from the centre army straight onto the goal «Ржавый узел» where a 75-strong Barons army stands, while the line still says «Тяните от армии на гекс рядом с ней»; following it and dropping «Атака» as coached cuts our army 75→6, the junction only drops to 51, and a second «Ничья» (−2,0) follows; the coach rings «Ещё бой» again. Cause (verified): _ftue_ghost_pair (7914) adds its +50/+100 bonus only to a flag neighbour with forecast f ≥ 1.0 and otherwise returns the raw best f — after the idle Draw no neighbour qualifies and the best is the flag hex itself; nothing rejects f < 1.0; «Ещё бой» keeps the post-Draw state; there is no F08 fallback (_start_offensive only zeroes the flag's garrison and fort, 3195–3203, not the army on it). Evidence: A/i_ru/09_battle1_idle_tick535.jpg, 10_result_idle.jpg, 13_retry_battle.jpg, 14_battle1_retry_tick171.jpg, 19_result_retry.jpg and log.txt lines 28–107 (ghost try 1 «(257,819)->(471,730)», retry «(471,913)->(684,819)», «battle1_retry: captured []»); A/i_en same frames. Fix per canon 08 §8.3: (a) the ghost never shows a pair with forecast f < 1.1 and never the flag while an enemy army stands on it; when no pair qualifies, the scenario weakens or pulls back the defender (as _ftue_clear_goal does for war 2) so the coached drag gives F ≥ 1.1 (F06); (b) the help ladder of 08 §8.3.2 in war 1: ghost at 6 s idle, camera on the target and a larger hit zone at 12 s, at 20 s a tap on the ringed target counts as the drag (level 3); (c) F08: if the goal is not ours by 0:55 of the tutorial offensive, its defender retreats and the hex counts at the end, so war 1 always ends ★★★ with the flag; (d) if a tutorial war still ends without its goal, «Ещё бой» restores both sides' armies and the goal's setup to the war's start. Acceptance: A's idle driver in ru and en — zero gestures → war 1 ends ★★★ with the flag on the first try; 40 s idle then the coached drag → ★★★; no ghost ever points at a hex with a red forecast; test_flow: idle war 1 → flag taken, 3 stars.
3. [medium] A player who follows the coach and then waits takes 2 hexes, and the Residence lesson (step 7) is skipped silently. Army drag + «Атака» on the flag as coached, then waiting: the flag falls with ~40 s left, the coach hides, the battle idles at energy 10/10, result ★★★ «+2 захвачено»; treaty 1 gives 9 hexes (canon §14.3: 7 → 10); at step 7 the DL2 gate returns err.need_hexes|10 and _ftue_tick sets ftue = 8 (≈8061) with no message, so «Здания → Резиденция» and the DL2 moment never happen and the tutorial ends 13/20. Cause (verified): _ftue_war_done (3414) ends early only when the haul reaches FTUE_PEACE1_HEXES (3); _ftue_peace1_pack (3961) takes at most the haul. Evidence: A/a_ru3/11–15_battle1_tick*.jpg, 15_result.jpg, 16_ftue6_treaty.jpg, 33_after_name_step7.jpg; A/f_ru/10–14, 32; A/a_en/11–15, 33; A/t_en/13, 16, 34; logs «battle1: captured [40, 48], energy 10, 20s left», «ftue=8 … hexes=9». Fix: when the flag falls with fewer than 3 hexes and time left, a step-4b coach with a ghost to the best winnable neighbour (f ≥ 1.1) and a short line (new key ru/en, e.g. «Ещё один гекс — и граница наша!»); the F08 retreat of item 2 also covers this third target at 0:55. Safety net: step 7 never skips silently — if hexes < 10 when it starts, waive the DL2 hex gate while ftue > 0 (economy.can_upgrade option) rather than jumping to step 8. Acceptance: A's follow-then-wait path (a_ru3/f_ru) gives +3 captured, treaty 1 → 10 hexes, the Residence lesson shows, tutorial card 14/20.
4. [medium] The DL2 evolution beat is lost and lands on the tutorial card. Step 7 starts Residence DL2 («через 1:00») and the coach moves to the vein in the same second; the Residence card then shows a green «Бесплатно» that no step uses (canon 00 §14.3 row 3:30–5:00: «Резиденция → УР2 (60 с, первое ускорение бесплатно): халупы становятся избами»); DL2 completes during war 2, where toasts are held, and «Резиденция: уровень 2 готов!» and «Уровень развития 2! Открыты новые постройки» arrive over «Обучение пройдено!» (triage saw it in A/b_ru2/25_tutorial_card.jpg). Evidence: A/b_ru2/02, 03, 07 (unused «Бесплатно»), 25; log 16.9 / 142.3 / 147.1 / 147.9; A/b_en/03, 25, 26. Fix: step 7c rings the Residence free-finish CTA with a line (new key), the free finish plays _dl_ceremony (4791) at once (DL toast + the map rebuild wave: huts become izbas), then step 8. If DL2 still completes inside a protected moment, hold its toasts until after the tutorial card's «Вперёд». Acceptance: shots ru/en at 941×1672 and 1080×2400 — ring on «Бесплатно», the DL2 wave on the map, no DL toast on the tutorial card.
5. [medium] The tutorial's own rewards overflow the 5 000 gold store. The coach-prefilled treaty 2 warns «Склад не вместит 490 золота» even with «Пощадить»; ceremony 2 shows «+2 714 · Склад полон» (gold 2 286 → 5 000/5 000); right after «Вперёд» comes «Почти нет места для золота — обменяйте на Рынке» about a Market the player has never seen; coin bubbles can no longer be collected. Cause (verified): treaty 2 is filled by War.recommend_package (main.gd 3944), which spends leftover points on «Контрибуция ×2–3» whatever the free storage; B saw the same in every late peace (B low: B/ch2/022_order_peace.png «Склад не вместит 4 430 золота» with 3× Контрибуция, B/ch3/019, B/ch4/024_ch4war_peace.png 56,4K). Evidence: A/b_ru2/22_ftue15_spared.jpg, 24_ceremony2_rewards.jpg, A/x_gold_b_ru2.jpg, log 153.0; A/b_en/26; A/c_ru/02–05; A/t_ru2/23. Fix in sim/war.gd recommend_package (it also fills the war-cap auto-treaty, main.gd 7676): take the free storage per resource (the gross snapshot _peace_overflow 4304 uses) and skip contribution / plunder-gold packages that would not fit (or take only what fits), leaving the points as opinion. Do not raise the DL2 gold cap (economy balance is out of scope). Suppress the «Почти нет места…» toast during the tutorial and its first minute after the card. Acceptance: FTUE treaty 2 shows no storage warning, ceremony 2 no «Склад полон»; a late peace with gold at the cap recommends no contribution (probe or B's ch4 phase); a test_sim/test_flow check.
6. [medium] The first free War Crate is 6 h away instead of 1 h. The tutorial card's only timer reads «5ч 57м»; canon 00 §14.3 row 9:30 (line 1218) and 08 lines 158/160: first War Crate 1 h after the FTUE, then every 6 h. Cause (verified): game/data/cases.json:12 has one interval; cases.gd claim_free_crates (545) starts it at now + every_sec. Evidence: A/b_ru2/25_tutorial_card.jpg, A/t_ru2/23. Fix: "first_sec": 3600 counted from the tutorial's end (ftue_done), every_sec after it. Acceptance: tutorial card shows ≤1 h; test_cases covers first and next.
7. [low] Plunder preselected in the FTUE treaties (canon 08 F31 line 153: «предвыбора нет»). Treaty 1 silently applies 30% (plunder_level defaults to 1, main.gd 4029), treaty 2 asks «Пощадить … или разграбить? Выберите» with 30% already lit. Fix: treaty 1 → 0 (spare); treaty 2 → no segment selected and the seal locked with its hint until the player picks. Evidence A/a_ru3/16, A/t_en/17, A/t_ru2/22.
8. [low] ru decimal point in the battle forecast chip «×7.2» (main.gd 3810, 3874 `"×%.1f" % f`): use the comma like the peace points. Evidence A/x_06both.jpg.
9. [low] toast.settlers (strings.csv 338) «…«%s» станет вашим через %s» does not agree with feminine names: ru «Поселенцы в пути: «%s» отойдёт вам через %s».
10. [low] Step 9 ring sits on «Форт» while the vein from step 8 is still selected, so the coached tap builds the fort on the inner vein hex. Fix: on entering step 9 clear the selection and ring a border hex by the Barons first, then «Форт» (two stages, like step 7). Evidence A/b_ru2/07, 09, log 37.9–44.0 («fort tapped first: ftue=0 sel 24->24»).
11. [low] At 941×1672 the coach advisor covers the treaty title «Мирный договор» and a toast sits under the coach plate on the war-1 result (A/x_20t.jpg, A/x_11top.jpg; fine at 1080×2400). Dock the advisor below a modal's title band (game_ui.gd coach 6296) and keep toasts out of the advisor rect.
12. [low] Ceremony reward tiles have no captions (A/x_21.jpg: «+1» with a city, «+3» with a bundle). Add a short caption under each tile (Гексы / Город / Ящик / Золото / Мнение / Карты) within the canvas budget.
steps.verify: Copy A/drv to your scratch and update it: real fresh boot std/tall ru/en (backing up user://); full FTUE ru/en at 941×1672 and 1080×2400 in the coached, idle (i_*), follow-then-wait (a_ru3/f_*) and b_* paths; shots of every changed beat (step 1 without modal, war 1 ★★★ idle, step 4b, step 7c ring + DL2 wave, treaty 2 without storage warning, tutorial card with ≤1 h crate and no DL toast, calendar after the card, step 9 ring on a border hex, treaty title clear at 1672); read them at real size. test_flow (new PASS lines for items 1–3, 5, 6), test_cases, test_sim, test_economy; ui_lint --strict, check_strings; canvas counts of the treaty, ceremony and tutorial card within +2.

steps.title: Wars and diplomacy in chapters II–IV: ultimatum vs a running war, the per-chapter war table, the opinion model, coalitions, pact and buyout prices, readiness
steps.instructions:
Fix every item below properly. Each comes from tester B (run + probe) and its cause was checked in code and canon by the triage — re-check before changing, adapt where the suggestion is wrong and say so. Chapter I and the FTUE must behave exactly as now unless an item says otherwise (test_flow and the tutorial rely on it).
1. [high] An unanswered ultimatum silently replaces a war the player is fighting. An ultimatum closed with ✕ stays pending; the player can still declare war on someone else; at the 4 h deadline main.gd 7352 calls _answer_ultimatum("refuse") which assigns `war = War.declare_war(...)` (≈7468) over the running war — no treaty, its war score lost, its occupied hexes left ours with no war, the map at war with the ultimatum's state. Evidence: B/drv/ult_probe2.gd output (Hamlets war with 6 occupied hexes, ws 26.4 → «war enemy=2 ult_refused=1, occupied Hamlets hexes still ours=6»), B/drv/ult_probe.gd, the ✕ on B/ch2/026_ultimatum.png. Fix: never assign over a non-empty war. While an ultimatum is pending, «Объявить войну» on any state is a lock with the reason (new key, e.g. «Сначала ответьте на ультиматум») and its tap reopens the ultimatum (the mail button already does, 1134); show its deadline on the HUD (mail badge or a chip) so ✕ is not a dead end. If a war the player did not start (AI strike war, coalition) begins while another state's ultimatum is pending, defer the refusal war until the running war ends (keep the ultimatum, extend its deadline). Acceptance: ult_probe2 re-run — no overwrite, each war ends by its own treaty; a test_flow case.
2. [high] Chapter I war numbers are used in every chapter. Verified: WAR_CAP_SEC 2 h (main.gd 159), TRUCE_SEC 30 min (60; truce writes at 1660, 4247, 4595–4597 use Time.get_unix_time_from_system() instead of now_s()), ai_energy_mult 600 / hegemon 660 in _start_offensive (3172), the AI counter-strike lands STRIKE_WARN_SEC = 20 min after every player offensive (_schedule_counter ≈7656), and inbox.war_cap.* texts hardcode «Война длилась 2 ч». Canon 00 §9.1 table (lines 567–571), §9.15 (830), §9.11 (732), 03 §2.4 (lines 149–150): cap 2 h / 24 h / 72 h (I / II / III+); truce 30 min / 8 h / 24 h; AI energy ×0.6 / ×0.8 / ×1.0, hegemon ×1.1; counter-strikes: chapter I scripted only, chapter II 4–6 h after an offensive, III+ Wolf 3–4 h, Raven 3–5 h, others 4–6 h, each announced 20 min ahead. Effect: in ch III a coalition member's strikes took 9 hexes and the 2 h cap signed «Мир с потерями · −9 гексов» (51→42) with no player decision; truces of 30 min let the same neighbour be farmed. Evidence: B/drv/facts.gd («WAR CAP: war ended 7201s … (chapter 2); truce left 1799s», «BATTLE opts ai_energy_mult=600 … (chapter 2)»), B/ch2/log.txt 574.1, B/ch3/log.txt 772.8 → 944.5. Fix: one per-chapter war table (keyed by the chapter at war start, saved in `war`) read by _war_cap (7367/7669), every truce write (via now_s()), _start_offensive opts, _schedule_counter (strike_at = now + archetype delay; the 20-min warning chip/letter when ≤ 20 min are left) and the inbox templates (cap length as a parameter). If cheap, canon §9.11 line 758: a cap that expires while the player has been away ≥ 24 h closes with a white peace. Acceptance: facts.gd re-run prints cap 24 h / 72 h, truce 8 h / 24 h, energy 800 / 1000 (1100 hegemon), ch II counter 4–6 h; B's ch3 coalition scenario no longer ends by a cap 2 h later; test_flow updated only where it relied on the 2 h cap after chapter I.
3. [high] The opinion model makes alliances (and the ch II star «Рукопожатие», the ally/«Призыв» layer, Fox/Owl swaps) practically unreachable. Verified: _opinion_add (6083) keeps one number per state, _opinion_decay decays everything 0.5/h, _opinion_of (6102) = memory − 10 (alarm) − 10 (shared border); no archetype base, no per-modifier decay, no «Союз +10». A daily gift (+10.5 at embassy 1) decays 12/day, so opinion only returns to where it was. Canon 06 §11.1–11.3 (lines 875–923): modifiers are static or memory instances; op_base Wolf −10, Fox +5, Turtle 0, Raven −5, Owl +10, hegemon −10 more; op_gift decays 0.25/h, op_peace_leftover 0.25, op_spared 0.2, op_plundered 0.15, op_annexed 0.05 (sum ≥ −40), op_war_memory 0.5 after the peace (−25 after a white peace), op_alliance +10 static…; each rate × the archetype memory multiplier (Turtle ×0.5, Wolf ×1.5; the Owl example in §11.3 uses 0.75). Evidence: B/drv/facts.gd (10 days of gifts: embassy 1 «d0:10.5 … d9:0.5», embassy 8 14 → 21.9, all «need 40+»), B/ch2/log.txt DIPL line, B/ch3/log.txt 275.8. Fix: per-state list of memory instances {code, value, at} with the 06 §11.2 rates, static terms computed in _opinion_of (op_base, border, alarm, war, alliance), clamp ±100; every _opinion_add call passes its code; save/load in save.gd with migration (an old stored number becomes one legacy memory decaying 0.5/h). Fold in A's low: the treaty bar «остаток: +N к мнению», the ceremony dove tile and coach ftue.15 must show the same net change the signed treaty really makes (leftover + spare − plunder − annex), not the leftover alone (A/b_ru2/22, 24, log «change +14»; A/t_en/17, 26, «change −7»). Acceptance: facts.gd gift loop — an Owl reaches 40+ within 7 days of daily gifts at embassy 1, a Wolf does not; the leader card shows the sum; a probe shows bar = dove = actual delta; save round trip keeps memories; test_sim/test_flow cases.
4. [medium] A coalition is built from AI states that are at war with each other (the League was attacking the Hamlets and both joined, the League as leader). _coalition_candidates (1346) ignores ai_wars. Evidence: B/ch3/log.txt 605.4 and 690.6, B/ch3/024_ch3_coalition_war_map.png, B/drv/verify2.gd (1) «ai_wars=[[4, 3]] coalition={leader 4, members [2, 3, 4]}». Fix: skip a candidate at war with another candidate (keep the stronger / the hegemon), or make joining end that AI war with a truce and an inbox line. Acceptance: verify2.gd re-run.
5. [medium] «Пакт» hides its price and charges 8 h of gross gold without confirmation (20 816 at DL6); when short it only says «Не хватает золота». game_ui.gd _leader_dialog 5488–5491 builds the act without a price, main.gd 6195 charges _pact_cost (1813). Evidence: B/ch3/010_ch3_leader_saren.png, 011_ch3_pact_tapped.png, log 284.0. Fix: a price chip [coin, cost] like «Подарок», the short reason «не хватает N», a hold or confirm for the spend; when the cost exceeds the gold cap, say the store cannot hold it. Acceptance: leader card shot with the price; tap when short shows the amount.
6. [medium] The ultimatum buyout is unpayable in chapter II (8 032 with the gold cap 6 750; B/ch2/026_ultimatum.png, ch2b/log.txt 67.7 7 008 vs 5 000). Verified: _issue_ultimatum (7411) sets tribute = 8 h gross gold and «Откупиться» charges all of it. The tester suggests a clamp, but canon 00 §10.4 (line 562) already prices the buyout lower: ONE fixed price = 50% of the tribute (or of the hex's gold equivalent max(8; 4 × value) h of gold), the Raven 75%, the Wolf has no buyout button. Implement the canon price (the demand line keeps the tribute) and clamp it to ≤ 90% of the gold cap so it is always payable with a full store. Acceptance: ch II ultimatum shot with a payable «Откупиться»; a Wolf ultimatum without the button.
7. [medium] Offensives have no readiness gate. Canon 00 line 121: an army attacks with Strength ≥ 50% of its max. «В атаку!» stays enabled and battles start with armies at 20% (B/drv/ready_probe.gd: armies 15/75 → big button enabled, battle with both). Fix in _offensive_primary (913) / _start_offensive (3156): armies below 50% stay out; with none ready the big button locks with «Армии восстанавливаются · mm:ss» (refill timer). The tutorial wars must still work (check their armies stay ≥ 50% or exempt ftue > 0). Acceptance: ready_probe re-run; the FTUE driver passes.
8. [low] AI colonization timers use the player's «orders» icon (blue banner with a star) — B/crop_chips.png, ch2/006: use a neutral icon id map_view already has (hourglass/tent) in _ai_colonize (≈2548); a new icon would be a map_view.gd patch for Q5.
9. [low] «Разбить лагерь» is red and enabled with no army next to the camp; the tap only toasts (B/ch2b/010, log 309.3–311.3). Lock it in the camp branch of _primary_for_selection (≈790) with «Нужна армия рядом» and a «Марш» shortcut.
10. [low] With the World tab already open on the chapter card, the big «Расширить мир» does nothing visible (B/ch2/003): let it start the expansion (_open_world_chapter 885 / _on_action "expand").
11. [low, if cheap] The defeat / white-peace offer reuses the battle-result layout (three empty stars, «Ещё бой / К миру») and never lists the ceded hexes before «К миру» (B/ch3/033, 041; _open_defeat_or_white 4484): no stars, the ceded hex tiles and the plunder share shown first.
steps.verify: Copy B/drv to your scratch: ult_probe2.gd, ult_probe.gd, facts.gd, verify2.gd, ready_probe.gd before/after logs; B's ch2/ch3 phase scripts (or demos) for shots of the ultimatum (payable buyout, Wolf), the locked «Объявить войну» with a pending ultimatum, the leader card with the pact price and opinion sum, a ch II war cap at 24 h, the coalition alarm card; FTUE smoke (A's driver, wars 1–2) because war code changed. test_flow (new PASS lines: ultimatum during a war, per-chapter cap/truce/energy, opinion decay + save round trip, readiness), test_sim; ui_lint --strict, check_strings; canvas counts of the leader card and ultimatum within +2.

steps.title: Platform and session: Android Back, the daily reset in local time, «Пока вас не было», legal texts and settings, state-name grammar
steps.instructions:
Fix every item below properly (sources: B and C, causes checked by the triage — re-check, adapt where needed and say so).
1. [high] Android Back quits the game from any screen, mid-battle included. Verified: game/project.godot has no application/config/quit_on_go_back override (Godot default true; B/probe_back.gd prints «quit_on_go_back=true auto_accept_quit=true») and no script handles NOTIFICATION_WM_GO_BACK_REQUEST (grep GO_BACK / ui_cancel / go_back in game/scripts is empty); main.gd _notification (595) only autosaves on pause/close. Spec 10 §5.4 (line 581): Back closes sheet → window → screen, asks «Выйти из игры?» on the map, is ignored in battle and ceremonies. On the owner's Samsung with gesture navigation a stray edge swipe while dragging a card quits mid-battle. Fix: quit_on_go_back=false; one back handler in main.gd: BATTLE / CEREMONY / expansion → ignore; an open sheet, window or picker → its own cancel path (the ✕ callback — the ultimatum stays pending, the flag wizard cancels, the shop closes); a modal without a cancel (treaty mid-hold, tutorial card) → ignore; a selected hex / march pick → deselect; the bare map → a «Выйти из игры?» choice that autosaves then quits. Map ui_cancel (Esc) to the same handler for desktop testing. Acceptance: a probe that sends the notification on the map, a window, the shop, the ultimatum, battle and ceremony prints the expected action each time; test_flow case.
2. [high] Legal texts and subscription terms are not reachable in the app (App Store 5.1.1(i) and 3.1.2, Google Play subscriptions policy). Verified: the patent window's «Условия» / «Конфиденциальность» links only toast patent.doc_soon (game_ui.gd 2499–2501); Settings (show_settings 3319) has Sound, Language, Manage subscription (stub), Restore (stub), New game and the build — no privacy, terms, support or licences; the trial button reads only «Пробный · 7 дней · 1,99 $» — patent.trial «7 дней за %s, затем %s в месяц» appears only in the intro-offer popup. Evidence: C/ru/world/04_patent.png, 05_patent_link_Условия.png, C/ru/prof/10_settings.png, C/en_sheet2.png, C/tall_ru/sheetD.png. Fix: game/data/legal.json (a .json is exported with export_filter=all_resources — do not touch export_presets.cfg, Q6 owns it) holding the privacy text ru/en (item 5), short terms ru/en (Apple standard EULA reference + game rules), and licences: Engine.get_license_text(), Engine.get_copyright_info() third-party summary, and the SIL OFL texts of Rubik and Nunito copied from game/assets/fonts/OFL-*.txt. Settings gets a well «Конфиденциальность · Условия · Поддержка · Лицензии»: privacy/terms open OS.shell_open(url) when ProjectSettings raivon/privacy_url / raivon/terms_url are set, else the bundled text in a scrolling window; «Поддержка» → mailto from raivon/support_email, hidden while empty. The patent links use the same. Under the patent purchase buttons the full terms are always visible (patent.trial + the 1-month period + patent.renewal); the pass says «на сезон 28 дней». Hosting the URLs and the owner's name/e-mail are release blockers, not part of this step. Acceptance: shots of Settings, each legal window (ru/en, scrolls, nothing clipped) and the patent window with its terms line; canvas within budget.
3. [medium] The daily reset is 04:00 UTC, while canon (00 lines 1165, 1626) and the UI («Следующая награда — завтра после 04:00») mean local time — US players reset in the evening before, the owner in Ukraine at 06:00/07:00. Verified: calendar.gd game_day (64), orders.gd 44, patent.gd 24 floor((now − 4 h)/86400) on Unix time; weekly.gd and patent.gd MONDAY «04:00 UTC»; no get_time_zone anywhere. Fix: one helper (local day = unix + bias minutes, Time.get_time_zone_from_system().bias) used by calendar, orders, patent and weekly; the bias is saved and may change at most once per 7 days (08 §8.8.4; the server check stays in the backlog); weekly resets Monday 04:00 local. Acceptance: test_calendar/orders/patent/weekly with biases −300, 0, +180, +540 around a day boundary; an old save keeps its streak.
4. [medium] No «Пока вас не было» flow (08 §8.14.1, lines 967–976). After any absence there is one toast and the auto-opened calendar; offline strikes and the war cap show only as toasts behind the calendar, and the strike toast is cut («…+2 к военному счёту, +27…»). Evidence: C/ru_away/*/log.txt, C/ru_away/d1war/01_back_1s.png. Fix: when now − saved_at ≥ 4 h, before the calendar (08 line 382), a summary window: income waiting/collected, each strike with its result (hex, held/lost, gold), wars closed by the cap, expired patent/trial/pass, number of new letters; «Собрать всё» and, when ads are allowed and the pool is > 0, «×2 (ролик)» = ad_offline_double capped 1/day (canon §15.2) through _rewarded(); under 4 h keep the toast but show a raid banner when a strike happened (decision 21). The strike toast becomes a short key, the long text stays in the inbox (_resolve_strike 7497). The 3–6 d / 7–29 d / 30 d+ return gifts are backlog. Acceptance: C's away.gd + run_away.sh at 5 h, 26 h with a war and a pending strike, 4 d — shots of the summary then the calendar; nothing truncated.
5. [medium] The privacy policy draft does not describe this build. docs/store/privacy_policy.md promises a year-of-birth screen, in-settings account deletion, RevenueCat, AdMob/MAX and Firebase — none exist; the build keeps a local save only and sends nothing while raivon/server_url is empty (net.gd). Rewrite it (en + ru) to what 0.9.x does, with a clearly marked «when these features arrive» section (server cloud save with a guest id, store billing, rewarded ads with consent, push), keep the [owner name] / [support e-mail] placeholders (release blocker), and use the same text in legal.json. Age gate, UMP/ATT consent and account deletion come with the ads SDK / server (release blockers).
6. [medium] About 20 ru templates put a plural verb after a state name, though 8 of 10 states are singular: «Речная Лига напали на Вольные Хутора», «Сарен прорвали оборону», ««Речная Лига» вышли из коалиции», «Альвария объявили войну»; en «The %s declared war» gives «The Alvaria…». strings.csv lines 473, 476, 620–621, 634, 636, 659, 662–663, 671, 675, 867, 879, 881, 882, 989–991, 996–997 (verified). Evidence: B/ch2/log.txt 574.1, ch2b 352.7, ch4 856.0, ch3 345.5/721.9/772.8/911.9. Fix: a grammatical-number flag per state with sg/pl variants through L.pack, or noun-first rewrites («Война: «%s» → «%s»»); drop «The» before state names in en; extend tools/check_strings.py to flag «%s» followed by a ru plural past-tense verb in state-name keys. Acceptance: a probe rendering every touched template with each of the 10 states reads grammatically in ru and en.
7. [low] iOS home-screen name: the iOS app uses the project name «Raivon: Territory Wars» (Android already uses package/name «Raivon»). Set a short localized name in project.godot (application/config/name_localized) — never change application/config/name (the desktop user:// folder derives from it) — and check CFBundleDisplayName in a local iOS export into your scratch (templates are in ~/.local/share/godot/export_templates/4.5.1.stable). If the iOS preset needs an option instead, write a patch for Q6 (game/export_presets.cfg).
8. [low] Settings has no vibration switch (sfx.haptic is used on openings and ceremonies): add «Вибрация», saved with the language in user://settings.json.
9. [low] Residence at the chapter cap says «Откроется в главе 3 / 5» — Arabic digits, and in chapter IV it promises a chapter V that is not in the build (canon §14.10). Feed the chapter through _chapter_roman and for the last released chapter show «Новые уровни — в следующих главах» (err.chapter_locked, economy.gd can_upgrade). Evidence B/ch4/log.txt 401.7.
10. [low] Engine error `Condition "!is_inside_tree()" is true` once per run when a tray-card CTA rebuilds the tray (A/b_en/godot.txt, A/b_ru2/godot.txt, A/c_*): ui_kit.gd press_out (5752) and its press-in sibling return early when the node is not in the tree.
steps.verify: Probes: back-button probe (map, window, shop, ultimatum, battle, ceremony, quit confirm), daily-day probe with several time-zone biases, a state-name grammar dump ru/en. C's away.gd/run_away.sh (restores the real save) at 5 h, 26 h war+strike, 4 d with shots. Shots ru/en at 941×1672 and 1080×2400: Settings, privacy/terms/licences windows, patent with the terms line, «Пока вас не было», the Residence lock text. A local iOS export's Info.plist CFBundleDisplayName. Tests: test_calendar, test_orders, test_patent, test_weekly, test_flow (new PASS lines for back handling, local day, the summary); 0 is_inside_tree errors in a FTUE driver log; ui_lint --strict, check_strings (with the new rule) clean.

steps.title: Purchases, cases and rewards deliver what they show: canon §4 storage rules, packs, the ×2 ribbon and ad, convoys, opening history, new game
steps.instructions:
Fix every item below properly (sources: C and B, causes checked by the triage — re-check, adapt where needed and say so). Purchases grant only in debug builds today (main.gd _on_buy_sku 5161 `OS.is_debug_build()`), but this is the delivery code billing will call, and the owner's test build is a debug export — it must be right now.
1. [high] Resources from crates, cases, the pass and packs burn silently at the warehouse cap. Verified: _on_open_case (5054) ignores the burned dictionary _apply_case_rewards (5085) returns (capped since the B3 fix); the reveal tile shows only «Ресурсы 16ч». Canon 00 §4 (line 327): «Ящики, кейсы, пасс, паки и докупка зачисляются сверх вместимости (излишек не защищён). Трофеи, грабёж, контрибуция, залежи и лагеря — до вместимости, остаток сгорает.» (the comment at 5085 already names this step). Evidence: C/ru/shop/13_reveal_royal10.png (gold and food 5 000/5 000 before and after; ~7 760 gold + 128 food lost from a 1 440-Raivite Royal ×10), 12_reveal_royal1.png (~970 gold lost), C/tall_ru/tall/03_reveal_x10.png, C/shots/royal.png. Fix: an economy path that credits above the cap for crates, cases, pass and calendar rewards and packs (the surplus is unprotected; income into a store above its cap stays stopped; the HUD shows e.g. «7 760/5 000» in an accent colour); the reveal's resource tile shows the credited amounts (icons + numbers, as the ceremony chest does, main.gd 4232–4243). Note the B3 history: the B3 review saw test_flow FAIL «collect all moves stock into storage (gold 6758 → 6758, cap 5000)» because an earlier case opening in the test put gold over the cap — fix the test's setup, do not cap cases again. Acceptance: Royal ×10 at full storage credits every unit (log before/after), the reveal tile shows the amounts; test_economy/test_cases/test_flow.
2. [high] Real-money packs do not deliver what they advertise and one-time packs stay on sale. Verified _on_buy_sku (5156): iap_starter gives 250 Raivites + 8 h resources only and can be bought again; iap_builder's second purchase gives nothing yet it stays on sale; iap_no_ads gives +200 only (its «Меценат» frame does not exist in cases.json); iap_ration +300 once, never the 60 per day. Canon 09 §9.8 table rows 7–10 and §9.8.4: starter = 250 Р + 8 h resources + Lady Vance (epic commander; if already unlocked, 40 of her shards) + the flag frame «Первый указ», limit 1 — NOT cos_frame_recruit as the tester suggested (that is the calendar's frame); builder — non-consumable, +1 builder + 300 Р; no_ads — non-consumable: a saved no_ads flag for the future interstitial gate + 200 Р + frame «Меценат», honest description (08/09: «Отключает ролики между боями навсегда. Ролики за награды остаются»); ration — 300 Р now + 60 Р per game day on login for 30 days, a World card «Паёк: день N/30 · Забрать 60», a missed day burns, a new one only after the current ends. Evidence: C/ru/shop2/log.txt and C/en/shop2/log.txt («PACK iap_* #1/#2 before/after», «vance=0 frames=[]», «ration next day raivite delta: 0»), C/ru/shop2/08_shop_packs.png, 09_pack_starter_tip.png. Fix: grants per canon (Lady Vance through the same unlock path as _grant_bram with Commanders.UNLOCK["epic"]), new cosmetics cos_frame_first_decree and cos_frame_patron in cases.json + flag_view.gd, ShopUI gets the purchases dictionary and shows owned one-time SKUs as «Куплено ✓» (no price, not tappable). Acceptance: C's shop2 phase ru/en — each pack's before/after matches its description; second purchase of one-time SKUs impossible; ration day 2 pays 60.
3. [high] The «Первая покупка ×2» ribbon stays on every Raivite tile after the first purchase, which then pays ×1. shop_ui.gd 692 draws it unconditionally; the doubling rule lives in main.gd (purchases.has(sku)), which the shop never sees (ShopUI.setup, main.gd 5046). Evidence: C/ru/shop2/07_raivite_bought2.png, log «raivite delta #1: 160 … ribbon … true … delta #2: 80»; also C/en/shop2, C/ru/shop. Fix: pass purchases to ShopUI.setup and draw the ribbon only for SKUs not bought yet — one source for display and grant. Acceptance: shot after one purchase: ribbon gone on that tile only.
4. [medium] The rewarded «×2 трофеи» has no daily cap, is never counted, and pays nothing when storage is full. Verified: main.gd 4368 offers _double_trophies whenever spoils and _ads_allowed(); _double_trophies (4404) never calls _rewarded() and credits through capped add_resources — trophies stay capped by canon §4, so at a full store the ad gives «+0». Canon 00 §15.2: cap 4 per day; ad counts feed the intro patent offer (3rd video) and the soft cap of 20. Evidence: C/en/ads/log.txt («PEACE 1..5 … x2 offered=true ad_counts={ }»), C/en/ads/01, 02; B/ch2/024_order_ceremony_end.png, B/ch2/034_day_away_inbox.png («+0 / +0»), B/ch3/021, B/ch4/026. Fix: offer it only when _ad_left("ad_double_trophies", 4) > 0 and the doubled part has free room (compute the real gain, show «+N» on the button); _double_trophies starts with `if not _rewarded("ad_double_trophies", 4): return`. Acceptance: 5 peaces in a day → offered 4 times; at full storage not offered; ad_counts increments.
5. [medium] A convoy can be sent while its resource is at the cap and comes back «Обоз привёз: +0 золота» (deposits are capped by canon §4, so the button must say so). deposits.gd can_send (92) ignores storage; main.gd _convoy_primary (835). Evidence: B/ch2b/008_deposit_selected.png, ch2b/log.txt 271.8–295.3, B/drv/verify2.gd (2). Fix: lock «Обоз» with «Склад полон» when the free room of its resource is below the cargo. Acceptance: shot of the lock with its reason; test_deposits case.
6. [medium] The odds window says «История последних открытий хранится в профиле», but no screen shows it (shop_ui.gd 404 shop.history; cases.gd keeps 100 entries, 705). Evidence: C/ru/shop/03_odds_case_war_crate.png, C/ru/prof/01_profile.png. Fix: an «История открытий» row in the profile (or a tab in the odds window) listing date, case, rarity, item, ru/en. Acceptance: shot after several openings.
7. [medium] «Новая игра» wipes paid entitlements and «Восстановить покупки» claims success without checking. main.gd _new_game (2642) → Save.wipe() (save.gd 367) deletes the whole save incl. purchases, the patent and the pass premium; restore just toasts patent.restored «Покупки проверены — всё на месте» (main.gd 344, 7027). Evidence: C/sheet_settings.png. Fix: a confirm window before the wipe listing what is lost and what is kept; keep entitlements (non-consumables, subscription, pass premium, a ledger of bought Raivites) in user://entitlements.json that wipe() leaves; restore re-applies that file and says what it found, or a neutral line until billing exists. Acceptance: probe — buy builder + patent (debug), new game → builder +1 and patent kept; restore message honest.
8. [low] The Royal case's «Цель: не выбрана» is plain text; the target can only be set from a commander card (C/ru/shop/02; main.gd 6828 _set_cmd_target): make it tappable → the commanders album filtered to target-able commanders.
9. [low] The 2 400 / 6 500 / 14 000 Raivite packs are drawn on the loot-case chests (shop_ui.gd PILES tiers 4–6; C/ru/shop2/07): crystal heaps or a sack of crystals from existing icons.
10. [low] On a tall phone a two-line toast covers the pass purchase footer for ~2 s (C/tall_pass_bottom.png; game_ui.gd _toast_spot 7120): place toasts above a purchase footer (pass, patent, shop).
steps.verify: Copy C/drv: meta.gd phases shop, shop2, ads, prof ru/en at 941×1672 and tall 1080×2400 (C's lib.gd tap transform), before/after logs of every pack and case at full storage; shots: reveal tile with amounts, packs tab with «Куплено ✓», the ribbon after one purchase, profile history, convoy lock, ×2 button with «+N» and its absence at full storage, the new-game confirm, the toast above the pass footer. Tests: test_cases, test_economy, test_deposits, test_pass, test_flow (new PASS lines); canvas counts of shop, reveal, profile and pass within +2; ui_lint --strict, check_strings.

steps.title: Late-game frame budget behind windows and on big fronts; battle floaters that do not pile up
steps.instructions:
Map-performance lane: you own game/scripts/map_view.gd only; the hooks this needs in main.gd / game_ui.gd and any new string go into patch files in your scratch (the game-code lane owns those files; the main session applies your patches after Q4). Measure before and after with the same views and say what each change saved.
1. [medium] Late-game frames are well over the ~330 3D+shadow budget. Tester B's log columns (3d, sh): result window over the ch III Alvaria front 327+194 = 521 and 344+236 = 580 (B/ch3/log.txt lines 315, 341 — 039_alvaria_result_0, 040_alvaria_result_1; the map is only a blurred backdrop there, triage viewed B/ch3/040_alvaria_result_1.png); ch III coalition result 351–360; ch IV war 296+110 = 406 (ch4 023) and 219+147 (027–029); ch II order war result 268+81 = 349 (ch2 021); DL8 strategic map after the Conclave war with 5 armies 366, DL8 ceremony 370, war declared 350; battle 294–366. Fix: (a) behind full-screen windows that cover the map (result, peace, defeat/white peace, ultimatum, expansion and info windows — NOT the ceremony, whose map wave and fireworks must stay live) freeze the 3D view: snapshot the frame once, show it under the UI, and stop 3D rendering (Viewport.disable_3d or equivalent) until the window closes — or at least drop the sun's shadows and the unit/fx layers behind it; expose map_view.set_frozen(on) and write the main.gd/game_ui.gd patch that calls it; (b) profile the DL6+ fronts (B/drv/ph_ch3.gd and ph_ch4.gd reach them; or demos) for the extra 100–150 shadow draws — tanks, aircraft, ships, fires, scorch, strike arrows and floaters outside BATCH — and batch them or turn their shadows off at strategic zoom; (c) DL8 strategic with 5 armies and the battle views ≤ 330. The close-zoom look must not change: standard look set + look_metrics before/after.
2. [low] Battle floaters pile up over plates and units in big offensives: «Оккупирован!» ×4, «Потерян» ×3 in low-contrast pink, «Котёл: 1» ×2 (B/crop_floaters.png from ch4/021_ch4war_battle_30s.png; ch2/019). Merge identical floaters within ~1 s into one with a count (string patch if a new key is needed), keep one «Котёл» chip per pocket, give «Потерян» a darker plate (contrast ≥ 4.5:1).
steps.verify: A perf table before/after for each view above (B's phase scripts or godot_shot demos; same zoom/focus/res), plus the std set, ch2/3/4 views and battle DL1/5/8 at 941×1672 and 1080×2400 — no view above ~330 3D+shadow, no UI screen above its canvas count + 2; shots proving the frozen backdrop looks identical to the live one (diff) and unfreezes on close; look_metrics std set unchanged; a battle shot with merged floaters; test_flow with your patches applied in a scratch copy (or headless with map_view only) — 275+ PASS, 0 SCRIPT ERROR; the patch files listed in the report.

steps.title: Store assets and release packaging: app icon, key art, feature graphic, screenshot sets, Android AAB with a current target SDK
steps.instructions:
Store/release lane (parallel to the game-code lane; you do not touch game scripts, project.godot or docs/store/privacy_policy.md). Judge every image at real size and at the sizes stores and launchers show it.
1. [medium] The app icon predates the Raivon Soft restyle. game/assets/icon/icon_512.png (last changed 2026-10-05) is a dark, realistic stone castle, blue on blue, its banners carry blank grey squares (C/icon_zoom.png); the same 512 px file is the iOS 1024×1024 icon (export_presets.cfg line 100, upscaled 2×); the Android adaptive foreground/background are empty (lines 44–45), so One UI on the owner's Samsung masks the full-bleed square and the top flag and side turrets fall outside the 66% safe circle. Fix: re-render tools/blender/render_icon.py in the Soft look (docs/art_direction.md §6: warm sky, the current capital model, the eagle emblem on the banners, readable at 48 px, no alpha) at 1024 → icon_1024.png (iOS + stores) and icon_512.png (project icon path stays the same), adaptive foreground 432 with the castle inside the central 66%, background 432 and monochrome 432; point both presets at them; import under the lock. Acceptance: a contact sheet at 1024/180/96/48 px and circle/squircle/teardrop mask previews.
2. [medium] Store key art docs/store/keyart_portrait.png (listing.md names it) still has the black hole behind the hut and the pale outline strokes that B4.6 fixed in the splash, and the banners show blank grey rectangles where the emblem should be (C/splash_keyart.png left = splash, right = store art; C/keyart_hole.png). Fix: re-run render_keyart.py + compose_keyart.py with the B4.6 settings into docs/store/keyart_portrait.png, eagle emblem on the banners in both the key art and the splash (game/assets/splash/splash.png, re-import), check the black-run and hairline checks B4.6 used. Acceptance: side-by-side and 4× crops of the hut area and a banner.
3. [medium] Missing store graphics: no Play feature graphic (1024×500), no store-size screenshot sets (Play phone 1080×1920 or 1080×2400; App Store 6.9"/6.7" 1290×2796; and iPad 13" 2064×2752 because export_presets targeted_device_family=2 includes iPad). Fix: tools/store_shots.sh producing a curated set in ru and en (map overview, a battle with cards, the peace treaty, the ceremony, a DL8 city, the commanders album) at each size via godot_shot --res into docs/store/screens/, plus the feature graphic from the key-art pipeline. iPad: if the 2064×2752 (3:4) layout is clean, ship iPad shots; otherwise set targeted_device_family to iPhone only and say so.
